topics.title: Write an email to a friend about a journey you had.
guiding_questions: What did you see and do?
How did you feel about the trip?
topics.sample_essay:
Dear Ahmed,
How are you? I had a great journey to Egypt. First, we flew to Cairo and visited the Pyramids. Then, we took a boat on the Nile River. We saw many amazing places and ate delicious food. Last of all, we bought nice souvenirs. I felt very happy. I wish you were with us.
Bye,
Khalid
